<description>
Part of #36692.

`blockpolicyestimator_tests`: Replace the transaction template, whose `prevout` index was overwritten to make each `txid` unique, with `make_tx()`, which constructs each transaction with `COutPoint`, `CTxIn` and `CTxOut` constructor calls.

Move the code that submits a transaction to the estimator, which was repeated in three places, into `add_tx()`. Each transaction is now built once and shared between its mempool entry and the estimator. The transactions submitted to the estimator and its estimates are unchanged.

`mempool_fee_estimator_tests`: Construct the input and output of `MakeRandomTx()` in place instead of resizing the vectors and assigning each field afterwards. Apart from the random `prevout` hash, the transaction is identical to before.
</description>
